description:
Manages PubNub apps with operations: list, create, update.
      - 'list': List all apps on your account.
      - 'create': Create a new app. User must provide data.name.
      - 'update': Update an existing app name. User must provide data.id and data.name.

name.description: Name of the app to create.

data.description: Operation-specific data. For 'list': not required. For 'create': {name}. For 'update': {id, name}.

operation.description: Operation to perform: 'list' to list all apps, 'create' to create a new app, 'update' to update an existing app.

name: manage_apps
title: Manage PubNub App
